subject: MedAlign SOC2 audit — scoped auth evidence & extraction plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@medalign.com>
Cc: k.iyer@redwood.ai, s.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedAlign SOC2 audit — scoped auth evidence & extraction plan

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. As discussed, MedAlign's SOC2 intake is scoped to authentication and provisioning controls for tenants in the prod cluster serving PHI workflows. To keep the handoff targeted, we propose the following deliverables by next Wednesday: 

- SCIM delta extracts for the last 90 days (per-tenant) — CSV or NDJSON ok.
- Representative SAML assertion logs for sign-on events around the audit window (sampled: 1 day/week for the quarter).
- RBAC ownership matrix (service accounts + human admin owners).
- Short narrative on ephemeral admin controls and just-in-time elevation flows.

We can provide the SCIM deltas as a compressed CSV and a short playback script that maps external IDs to tenant IDs. For SAML logs we typically redact PII and provide the assertion Subject, NameID format, Issuer, and Assertion timestamps.

Questions for you:
1) Do you need the SCIM extracts broken out by environment (prod-us, prod-eu) or a single merged extract?
2) Any specific redaction rules your auditors require beyond emails/usernames?
3) Who should we send the Box/Drive upload link to for ingest (Alicia and security@medalign.com ok)?

I'll route the artifacts through our security intake (cc'd: k.iyer and s.lee) for redaction and delivery. If you prefer SFTP, we can set that up — otherwise we'll use a shared Drive folder with restricted access.

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
Attachments: access-ownership-matrix.xlsx (stub)
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@medalign.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medalign.com
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedAlign SOC2 audit — scoped auth evidence & extraction plan

Marissa —

Thanks, that plan looks good. A few clarifications from the audit team:

- Please separate prod-us and prod-eu extracts (data residency is being checked).
- Redact personal identifiers (user email and full name) in SCIM where possible; retain stable internal IDs and timestamps.
- For SAML we need the full Issuer and Assertion ID for traceability; masking is fine for NameID if you include a stable pseudonym.

Upload to the Drive folder you create and add security@medalign.com plus our auditor (auditor@trustassure.com) as viewers. If there's any PHI in assertion attributes, mark the file and we'll set up SFTP.

Also: do you have a compact mapping of service accounts vs tenant IDs? That would be helpful.

—Alicia
Director, Security & Compliance
MedAlign Health
From: Karthik Iyer <k.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>, Alicia Park <alicia.park@medalign.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <s.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedAlign SOC2 audit — scoped auth evidence & extraction plan

Alicia / Marissa —

I've scoped the extraction tasks across the team. Quick notes: 

- SCIM deltas: We'll produce two CSVs (prod-us, prod-eu). Each line will include internal_user_id, tenant_id, timestamp, operation, and a pseudonymized user_key. We will explicitly strip emails and full names; retention of user_key allows auditor linkage.

- SAML assertions: We'll extract the assertion envelope with Issuer, AssertionID, Subject(pseudonym), Conditions, and AuthnStatement. If any assertion contains PHI in attributes, we'll flag for SFTP and apply additional access controls.

- Service account matrix: attaching a draft (access-ownership-matrix.xlsx) that maps service_account -> primary_owner -> tenant_scope. We'll finalize after Soojin's inventory pass.

Action items and owners: 
- Karthik: run SCIM delta job and produce CSVs (ETA EOD Tue 2027-08-31).
- Soojin: review RBAC matrix and annotate admin elevation patterns (ETA Tue lunchtime).
- Marissa: create Drive folder and invite Alicia, security@medalign.com, auditor@trustassure.com.

We'll include a short README describing redaction rules and a checksum for files.

-Karthik
Staff Engineer, Security Data
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-scim-delta-sample.csv (stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@medalign.com>, security@medalign.com, auditor@trustassure.com
Cc: k.iyer@redwood.ai, s.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedAlign SOC2 audit — scoped auth evidence & extraction plan

Hi Alicia / team —

Folder created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3redwood-medalign-audit (viewers: Alicia, security@medalign.com, auditor@trustassure.com).

Upload plan: 
- redwood-scim-prod-us-20270831.csv.gz (SCIM deltas, PII pseudonymized)
- redwood-scim-prod-eu-20270831.csv.gz (SCIM deltas, PII pseudonymized)
- saml-assertion-samples-202708.csv.gz (sampled assertions, NameIDs pseudonymized)
- access-ownership-matrix-v1.xlsx (service account / owner mapping)
- README-redaction-and-checksums.md

Karthik and Soojin will upload by EOD tonight. If the auditor needs the raw logs instead of sampled assertions, let us know and we'll coordinate SFTP.

Thanks — we'll mark PHI-bearing artifacts and follow your SFTP preference for those.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
